description.value:
By reading the microcosm of a creature, you gauge the macrocosm it can call on.

Cosmo Sense ◆ (single action)

Attempt a check to Recall Knowledge about a creature within 60 feet, using your key ability modifier in place of the relevant skill.

Success You learn its level relative to yours (higher, equal, or lower) and its single highest and lowest saving throws.

Critical Success As success, and you also learn its current focus or spell resources, or that it has none.

This is a fortune-free, magic-based sense: it reads the cosmo beneath, so it works through disguise and illusion.
